subject: Draft MAP for security review & SOC 2 artifacts — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwooding.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@bluecrestcap.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluecrestcap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwooding.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwooding.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security milestone (SOC 2 artifacts)

Thanks again for the intro call today — appreciate the context on Bluecrest's timeline and your info-sec bar. Per our discussion I sketched a short Mutual Action Plan focusing on the security review / SOC 2 artifact deliverable so we have clear owners and dates. High-level notes and asks below. Please confirm or update.

Summary (from today's call)
- Goal: complete security review and delivery of SOC 2 evidence pack to Bluecrest by 2027-06-15 so legal/compliance can finalize procurement review by 2027-06-30.
- Primary dependency: Bluecrest to provide a list of systems in-scope and the egress/IP allowlist for test connections.
- Redwood deliverable: SOC 2 questionnaire answers, evidence index, pointer to audit reports, and secure artifact transfer.

Draft MAP milestone (security / SOC 2)
1) Bluecrest: Provide in-scope system list + shared sftp/temporary bucket creds — owner: Priya — due: 2027-05-18
2) Redwood: Draft SOC 2 responses (Q&A) + evidence_index template — owner: Ben — due: 2027-05-20 [attached: SOC2-questionnaire_v1.xlsx, evidence_index_template.csv]
3) Security deep-dive (technical) meeting — owner: Evelyn to run — target window: 2027-05-24 to 2027-05-26
4) Evidence upload & verification — owner: Priya (upload) / Evelyn (verify) — due: 2027-06-07
5) Final package delivery (encrypted transfer & confirmation) — owner: Ben — target: 2027-06-15

Open questions / dependencies
- Which AWS account(s) should we use for temporary test access? (need account IDs + preferred CIDR allowlist)
- Does Bluecrest require an executed NDA before the security call? (you mentioned an internal policy)
- Any specific format constraints for evidence (PDF preferred, max 10MB per file)?

Next steps
- Priya: confirm system list + preferred transfer method by 2027-05-18
- Ben: circulate MAP spreadsheet with explicit owners (I'll attach v2 after I get your system list)
- Evelyn: propose 2 slots for security deep-dive by EOD 2027-05-13

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire_v1.xlsx (draft), evidence_index_template.csv

Thanks — I'll update the MAP after I get your inputs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwooding.com | (415) 555-0193
[Attachment: SOC2-questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: evidence_index_template.csv (csv)]

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@bluecrestcap.com>

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluecrestcap.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwooding.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwooding.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security milestone (SOC 2 artifacts)

Thanks Ben — this looks good and aligned with our timeline. A few clarifications from Bluecrest: 
- We'll confirm the in-scope systems by 2027-05-18. That will include the prod account ID and a staging account ID.
- No NDA required for the initial technical deep-dive; legal requires the completed SOC 2 questionnaire and a pointer to the report before procurement signs off.
- Evidence format: PDF preferred. We can accept a secure S3 transfer (pre-signed URLs) or an encrypted zip via the transfer bucket.

One request: can you include a short column in the evidence index for "retention period" so our compliance team can map artifacts to our retention policy?

I'll loop Priya to confirm the system list and upload plan.

Regards,
Liam O'Rourke
Director, Platform Risk | Bluecrest Capital
liam@bluecrestcap.com

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security milestone (SOC 2 artifacts)

Thanks — I can run the technical deep-dive. A couple of notes from Redwood Security: 
- For evidence verification we'll need (examples): network diagrams (PDF), change-control logs (CSV/CSV export from ticketing), encryption key rotation policy (PDF), SAML metadata (XML) if you use SSO, and IAM role ARNs for any service accounts we need to validate.
- Temporary test access: we prefer pre-signed S3 URLs for transfer and a separate ephemeral IAM user for read-only verification where absolutely required. Please do not send permanent credentials over email.
- Please include system owner contact (name + email + phone) in the in-scope list — saves back-and-forth during evidence collection.

I can propose two slots for the deep-dive: 2027-05-25 09:00-10:00 PT or 2027-05-26 13:00-14:00 PT. Which works for Bluecrest?

Evelyn Hart
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwooding.com
